organism: Glomerella lagenarium
assay: heterologous expression in Aspergillus oryzae; product isolated and identified as T4HN (tetraacetate)
quote: The main compound produced by an A. oryzae transformant was isolated and characterized to be 1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (T4HN) as its tetraacetate.

organism: Glomerella lagenarium
assay: in vitro characterisation of Pks1; the thioesterase domain cyclises and deacetylates an enzyme-bound hexaketide
quote: Here, in vitro characterization of Pks1 from Colletotrichum lagenarium establishes a true THN synthase with a bifunctional thioesterase (TE) catalyzing both cyclization and deacetylation of an enzyme-bound hexaketide substrate.

organism: Exophiala dermatitidis
assay: gene disruption in the fungus; albino phenotype. The abstract does not show the product of WdPks1p; the hexaketide AT4HN is shown in the WdYG1 deletion mutant (PMID 18676950)
quote: The resulting wdpks1Delta disruptants showed no morphological defects other than an albino phenotype and grew at the same rate as their black wild-type parent.

organism: Aspergillus fumigatus (strain ATCC MYA-4609 / CBS 101355 / FGSC A1100 / Af293)
assay: heterologous expression in Aspergillus oryzae; product identified as the heptaketide naphthopyrone
quote: The Alb1p PKS product in this heterologous expression system was identified as heptaketide naphthopyrone instead of pentaketide T4HN.

organism: Aspergillus niger (strain ATCC MYA-4892 / CBS 513.88 / FGSC A1513)
assay: complementation of the colour mutant and targeted disruption in the fungus; colour phenotype. The abstract does not name the product of the enzyme (FwnA, An09g05730). The same abstract reports that naphtho-gamma-pyrones depend on fwnA; YWA1 is not named
quote: The fawn phenotype was complemented by a PKS protein (FwnA, An09g05730), the ovlA mutant by An14g05350 (OlvA) and the brnA mutant by An14g05370 (BrnA), the respective homologs of alb1/pksP, ayg1 and abr1 in A. fumigatus.

organism: Aspergillus fumigatus (strain ATCC MYA-4609 / CBS 101355 / FGSC A1100 / Af293)
assay: enzyme purified from an Aspergillus oryzae overexpression strain; YWA1 converted to T4HN with release of acetoacetic acid
quote: The Ayg1p converted the naphthopyrone YWA1 to T4HN with a release of the acetoacetic acid.

organism: Aspergillus fumigatus (strain ATCC MYA-4609 / CBS 101355 / FGSC A1100 / Af293)
assay: cell-free assay with crude Ayg1p extract; heptaketide product of Alb1p shortened to T4HN
quote: Cell-free enzyme assays, using the crude Ayg1p protein extract, revealed that Ayg1p enzymatically shortened the heptaketide product of Alb1p to 1,3,6,8-THN.

organism: Aspergillus niger (strain ATCC MYA-4892 / CBS 513.88 / FGSC A1513)

organism: Exophiala dermatitidis
assay: gene replacement in the fungus; the mutants accumulate AT4HN and 3-acetylflaviolin (chemical analysis of cultures)
quote: Chemical analyses of mutant cultures demonstrated that melanin biosynthesis was blocked, resulting in the accumulation of 2-acetyl-1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (AT4HN) and its oxidative product 3-acetylflaviolin in the culture media.

organism: Pyricularia grisea
assay: enzyme produced in Escherichia coli and purified; substrate competition between T4HN and T3HN. The second reductase (4HNR) prefers T4HN by a factor of 310
quote: Substrate competition experiments indicate that the second reductase prefers tetrahydroxynaphthalene over trihydroxynaphthalene by a factor of 310; trihydroxynaphthalene reductase prefers trihydroxynaphthalene over tetrahydroxynaphthalene by a factor of 4.2.

organism: Pyricularia grisea
assay: enzyme produced in Escherichia coli and purified; substrate competition between T4HN and T3HN. Minor activity: T3HN is accepted with a 310-fold lower preference than T4HN
quote: Substrate competition experiments indicate that the second reductase prefers tetrahydroxynaphthalene over trihydroxynaphthalene by a factor of 310; trihydroxynaphthalene reductase prefers trihydroxynaphthalene over tetrahydroxynaphthalene by a factor of 4.2.

organism: Aspergillus fumigatus (strain ATCC MYA-4609 / CBS 101355 / FGSC A1100 / Af293)
assay: gene deletion in the fungus; arp2 deletants accumulate flaviolin only, the arp1 deletant accumulates scytalone and flaviolin
quote: The presence of a DHN-melanin pathway in A. fumigatus was supported by the accumulation of scytalone and flaviolin in the arp1 deletant, whereas only flaviolin was accumulated in the arp2 deletants.

organism: Aspergillus fumigatus (strain ATCC MYA-4609 / CBS 101355 / FGSC A1100 / Af293)
assay: Inferred. The abstracts that were read (PMID 10515939, 11350964) do not show the reduction of T3HN by Arp2. The six-gene cluster has one reductase; a second reductase outside the cluster was not checked.

organism: Pestalotiopsis fici (strain W106-1 / CGMCC3.15140)

quote: Combining genetic deletion and combinatorial gene expression of Pfma cluster genes, we determined that the putative reductase PfmaG and the PKS are sufficient for the synthesis of scytalone.

assay: The abstract of PMID 12967213 deduces a T4HN-specific reductase from a double mutant; it does not name T4HR1 and shows no assay of this protein. The UniProt entry cites the paper for the sequence.
